Otherling | Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer | Hybrid NYC or LA | Full Time

Otherling is a fashion e-commerce startup helping consumers discover emerging luxury brands. We're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to design, build, and maintain our platform end-to-end.

REQUIREMENTS - 4+ years in software development (CS degree or equivalent) - React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS - Python or Node.js - SQL/NoSQL/Postgres and data modeling - REST and/or GraphQL APIs - Docker and AWS (ECS, Cognito, S3, Lambda, RDS) - Shopify platform and API development - Plus: startup or luxury-fashion interest

APPLY Email otherling@vornoy.com, subject 'Otherling dev'. Include your resume and location (New York or Los Angeles).
